rootCauses: Asymmetric flight-length arms were constrained to identical wrist targets, forcing one walk elbow to86.7 degrees.
Flight hand orientations stayed fixed during locomotion; waist-level wrist targets removed pendulum swing.
Entire foot quaternion was locked in runtime stance, erasing authored heel and toe articulation.
Nonuniform per-bone stretch introduced shear that glTF TRS could not represent; uniform segment corrections preserve joint attachment.
The old mount-leg override reused flight segment lengths at its ground endpoint.
Foot lock reach-release moved x/z without resampling height at the new support point.
changes: Matched ground-only leg/arm segment sizes; static geometry and8flight clips preserved.
FK arm counter-swing, relaxed walk elbows, bent run elbows, pelvic/shoulder counter-rotation, calmer wand wrist.
Heel→toe pivots, swing clearance and stable knee poles; release impossible locks once per stance.
Purposeful extending walk support and athletic run landing/compression/recovery; delayed distal cape motion.
visualReview: Root owns browser captures, final front/side acceptance and map movement review.
